input.title: Aventon Aventure M
input.descriptionHtml:
Aventon Aventure M mid-drive fat tire ebike - A100 motor with 100Nm torque, 26\"x4\" Inova tires, suspension fork & seatpost, E-Shifter, Autoshift, Auto Mode, rack, fenders & kickstand included. Avail

Aventon Aventure M
Mid-Drive Fat Tire Ebike

 

The Aventon Aventure M is where the proven Aventure fat tire platform meets mid-drive performance. Aventon's A100 motor delivers 100Nm of torque with a natural, terrain-responsive power feel that hub-drive bikes can't replicate - and pairs it with an electronic E-Shifter and optional Autoshift functionality that selects the optimal gear based on your cadence, speed, and power output automatically. Auto Mode goes a step further, using internal sensors to adjust motor support based on slope and terrain in real time, so you can ride without ever thinking about pedal assist levels. The Aventure M rolls on Inova 26"x4.0" puncture-resistant fat tires with an 80mm lockout suspension fork and 50mm travel suspension seatpost, handling pavement, gravel, dirt, sand, and snow with equal confidence. Rack, fenders, and kickstand are all included. Available by special order at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL in Regular and Large sizing.

The ACU connected platform delivers 4G/GPS tracking, an integrated rear wheel lock, startup password protection, motion detection and alarm, geofencing, remote shutdown, and over-the-air firmware updates - all managed through the Aventon MyRide app. The Aventure M ships as Class 1 and is convertible to Class 2 or Class 3. Throttle is compatible but not included and must be purchased separately. Note: 4G connectivity is complimentary for the first year; a paid subscription is required after that period.

E-Bikes are subject to a $160 assembly & tuning fee

The Aventure M is a special order item at Quest Watersports - we don't stock it on the floor, but we can get one for you. Lead time is typically 1-2 weeks subject to Aventon's inventory. Let us order one for you today - call 815.433.2200 or email contact@questwatersports.com.

Included with every Aventure M:

  • Rear rack (integrated)
  • Full fenders, front and rear (integrated)
  • Kickstand (rear mount)
  • Integrated front and rear running lights
  • Suspension seatpost (50mm travel)
  • 9/16" alloy platform pedals
  • 42V 4A charger
 

Note: Throttle is compatible but not included. Adding a throttle converts the bike to Class 2.
